title: Personal Loans Returned-Payment Fees: First-Return Share
content:
## Rule

A first-return share of a Personal Loans returned-payment fee applies, looking at the time fewer than 12 whole calendar months (whole calendar months being the difference in calendar months, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's) before the returned-payment fee's assessment date: no returned payment on the loan in that time other than the one being charged (the one being charged is left out of the count only when it falls in that time), and 12 or more net installment payments in it (payments of type scheduled installment posted, less one for every payment returned whatever it was for), give 0.75; no other returned payment and fewer than 12 such payments give 0.85; any other loan gives no returned-fee share.

The share multiplies the returned-payment fee amount while it is still unrounded.

| Other returned payments in that time | Net installment payments in it | Share |
|---|---|---|
| none | 12 or more | 0.75 |
| none | fewer than 12 | 0.85 |
| one or more | any | no share |

## Cases (hypothetical, assessment on 9 November)

- The return being charged is dated 2 November and no other return falls in the time; 13 scheduled-installment payments in the time: 13 less the 1 return is 12: 0.75.
- The return being charged is dated 9 November of the year before (12 whole months back, outside the time) and no return falls in the time; 8 scheduled-installment payments: 0.85.
- One other return on 10 November of the year before: 11 whole months back, inside the time: no share.
